status: Architecture and space reservations, not fabrication geometry or measured performance

policy.transfer_configuration: Ordinary vacuum, normal powered head installed, extension parked; core and battery carried; cap replaced by lift

body_interface_allowances.basis: Two station-released positive locks and locators; no onboard latch motor
Common smooth air face, short stub and gasket; supplements retained common duct/flex allowance
Body half of keyed connector, seating/retention sensing
Local interface wiring in addition to existing vacuum harness
Unfinished local interface detail; explicit allowance

normal_head_adapter.basis: Removable head-side adapter/contact allowance; parked with normal head during sofa work, carried during ordinary vacuum flight

extension_additions.basis: About 49 g stock for two 245 and two 160 mm aluminum strips, 15 x 1.5 mm; balance for brackets/fasteners. Not a strength-qualified frame
Two nonmarking swivel wheel assemblies, 35 g each nominal; no SKU selected
Tool-side articulated hitch, yaw restraint, pins/bushings and retainers
Tool-side receiver adapter and electrical contacts
Local interface/control board; shared body supervisor remains aboard
Front contact/cliff sensing for tool overhang; existing body sensors remain
Cart/hitch power and sensor wiring beyond inherited moving-stage lead
External cart installation detail not in inherited telescope allowances

room_clearance.question: For each sofa, is there roughly 650 mm (26 inches) of clear floor directly in front, with about 1 m (40 inches) of turning space nearby?
room_clearance.scope: Owner confirms approximate space at both sofas; not a surveyed obstacle map or confirmation of station exchange-apron space.

head_exchange.direction: Negative Y, straight toward the front, with body captured and head supported level at nominal height
head_exchange.normal_head_compliance: Keep the floating head between a removable fixed adapter and the cleaning head; the dock supports and locates it before unlocking. Do not rigidly latch the moving roller body to the chassis.
head_exchange.mass_rule: Same receiver plate stock and existing O/M interface, head-mount, lift and riser allowances. No added hardware or credited overlap savings in this placement review.
head_exchange.scope: Nominal straight withdrawal of head/motor allocation boxes and sampled receiver clearance only. Adapter, locks, flex disconnection, pin engagement, fastener access and loaded deflection remain to detail.

retained_scope: Keep all N/M vacuum frame, common plumbing, side brush, electronics, sensing, 90 g head-mount, 62 g lift and 22 g riser allowances. Only the five ledger items assigned to vac_head/vac_head_drive leave with the ordinary head. Reconcile replacement hardware during detailed interface design before claiming further savings.
